seo_title: Find No GPA Scholarships for International Students USA
seo_description: No GPA scholarships for international students in the USA. Compare awards, deadlines, and eligibility, then apply on provider application paths.
intro: Trying to apply in the USA without a GPA cutoff ruling you out? This filtered view brings together scholarship listings that tag international students and show no GPA requirement, so you can find options that may fit even if your grades do not map neatly across systems or a minimum GPA is not listed. The programs below span areas such as education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and more, with study levels ranging from high school senior through college and graduate study. Awards vary widely by listing, and deadline wording differs from row to row, so compare each entry carefully. Requirements are mixed as well: some listings may be lighter-touch, while others may still ask for essays or additional materials, which you should review on the provider application path before you apply.

supporting: Use this slice to compare more than just the title. faq.question: Can I apply without a GPA to every scholarship listed here?
faq.answer: No GPA requirement is the shared filter, but you should still compare each listing carefully before you apply. Other criteria may still vary by row, including study level, field of study, citizenship or residency labels, and whether extra materials are requested.

faq.question: What should I compare when I browse these no-GPA scholarships?
faq.answer: Focus on eligibility, study level, category, field of study, award amount, and deadline text shown in each row. ScholarshipTop highlights available deadline and award details in a structured format so you can prioritize opportunities and plan your next step.
